thread:
mel: Heads-up — starting a small sync to scope a curated Terra-kit for CloudPartner X. Goal: opinionated Terraform module + CI/tests + one-click marketplace packaging. Want to align on scope and owners.

alex: Nice. Which clouds/regions are in scope for v1? AWS + GCP? any required compliance targets?

mel: AWS (us-west-2) + GCP (us-central1) to start. No hard compliance certs for v1, but include hooks for KMS/HSM in variables.

carla: Partner asked for branding + minimal security checklist. We should add guidance for key rotation and audit logs. Also need the legal-approved logo package.

raj: Proposal: provide 3 modules — network (vpc/subnets), compute (gpu instance pool + autoscaler), and deployment (helm chart + infra). Include an e2e smoke test that deploys a small LLM sample and verifies /health.

mel: +1. Keep module surface minimal: inputs for instance type, disk size, k8s node labels, and optional autoscaling. We'll document recommended instance families for cost/latency tradeoffs.

dylan: I can draft the compute module skeleton and CI. Plan to use GitHub Actions with terratest for smoke checks. Anyone opposed to gha?

alex: GHA is fine. Make sure the CI has an opt-out for customers who need self-hosted runners.

partner-bot: CloudPartner X PM (sara@cloudpartnerx.com) confirmed they're available for a tech review next Wed 10am PST.

carla: I'll coordinate logo/legal and add a section in the playbook about partner co-marketing approvals.

mel: Draft playbook checklist (working):
- module repo skeleton + LICENSE/CONTRIBUTING
- inputs/outputs docs + examples
- smoke test (terratest) + GH Actions workflow
- packaging script to produce marketplace bundle (manifest + checksum)
- KMS/HSM integration example config
- cost/instance guidance table + perf notes
- partner branding assets and approval steps
- security checklist and audit log example

raj: Could we include a small snippet for the compute module README to set expectations? e.g.:
```
module "llm_compute" {
  source = "github.com/redwood/terra-kit/modules/compute"
  instance_type = "c7g.large"
  gpu_count = 1
  autoscale = true
}
```

dylan: I'll wire up a minimal GH Action: `ci.yml` will run `terraform init && terraform validate && terratest` and then `terraform plan` with `-out`. Will stub secrets via repo secrets.

alex: Ownership: mel (PM) for playbook, dylan (eng) for CI + sample, raj (infra) for module semantics, carla (partner) for branding/legal. I'll create the tracking ticket and assign.

mel: Perfect. Action items: dylan to open repo skeleton PR by EOD, raj to draft smoke test scenario, carla to collect partner assets, alex to spin up tracking ticket and invite partner to review.

dylan: On it — PR today. FYI I'll include an opt-in benchmarking script that hits the sample endpoint and logs p50/p95 latency.

partner-bot: Reminder scheduled: tech-review meeting with CloudPartner X -> Wed 10:00 PST (invites sent).

alex: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

mel: Thanks — will post the initial playbook doc link here once I have the skeleton: <https://redwood-internal/docs/terra-kit/cloudpartnerx-playbook|internal doc>

carla: Thanks! I'll ping legal for the logo pack.

raj: +1, will put the smoke test in `tests/e2e/smoke_test.go`.

dylan: PR: https://github.com/redwood/terra-kit/pulls/112 (skeleton) — added README and GH Actions stub.

mel: Great progress. Keeping thread for sync notes and action tracking.
